newsitem.title: DENMARK: New record in sight for Danish shares on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: New record in sight for Danish shares on Greenspan.

text.p: Danish shares soared on Wednesday following U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's positive Humphrey Hawkins testimony with dealers saying the index was well on the way to hitting new records.
The top-20 KFX index had soared by 4.75 points or 2.49 percent to 195.34 by 0955 GMT.
"The market is steaming on to a new record. Greenspan's speech has set a major revival going," one dealer said.
The last KFX all-time closing record high of 195.61 was recorded on July 17 - the 13th record in July and the 47th in 1997.
The market suffered two days of losses due to correction before again recovering on Tuesday to close 2.03 points up.
